title: prunus yazdiana
intro: Prunus yazdiana, commonly known as Iranian plum or wild plum, is a deciduous shrub or small tree native to the Middle East and Central Asia. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine for its potential health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Prunus yazdiana are attributed to its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and alleviate respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents of Prunus yazdiana include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
